## Aug 17 Results: The Data Delivered

Look at this stat: 9 wins, 2 losses, 81.8% accuracy. That's not luck, that's what happens when you let the numbers do the talking. Out of 10 predictions yesterday, we hit on 9 of them. The model ran hot, and the results speak for themselves.

content.value:
## Breaking Down the Misses

Two misses out of 10 picks. The second Cardinals game and the Pirates pick at 51% confidence. Here's what the data shows: our lowest confidence pick (Pirates at 51%) missed—that's a coin flip territory, and sometimes the coin lands the other way. The Cardinals doubleheader split happens. When you're at 63% confidence, you're still expecting to lose 37% of the time. That's probability, not failure.

## Aug 18 Preview: Yankees-Orioles Takes Center Stage

Tomorrow's top pick according to the model: Yankees over the Orioles at 61% confidence. Carlos Rodón takes the mound for New York against Baltimore's Shane Baz. Look at the pitcher matchup data—Rodón's recent metrics align with our probability model. The numbers favor the Yankees in this AL East showdown.
